'''MK-RU''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was part of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[Kaas City]]. An unidentified Imperial delivered a package to this droid while it was in Kaas City. They worked with [[Manda (Human)|Manda]] and [[Minder Twenty]].<ref name="TOR" />
